verses.1: He sits in a hiding place, covered with the shadow of thorns.
verses.2: I say to the LORD, “My refuge and my strength, I will trust in You.”
verses.3: For he will protect you from the depths of hell.
verses.4: In Eberatho, he will protect you; beneath his wings, you will be safe from harm and danger.
verses.5: Do not be afraid of the night from the edge of Ya’uf.
verses.6: From Medebor Ba’ofel, it will go from the north to the south.
verses.7: Thousands and millions will fall from your side; they will come towards you from your right side. But they will not be able to reach you.
verses.8: Only in your eyes can you see and understand the wicked.
verses.9: For you, Jehovah, are my protector; you have taken care of me.
verses.10: May no harm or trouble come to you; let none enter your tent.
verses.11: For his servants will command you to keep your word in all your ways.
verses.12: They will carry you on their shoulders, so that your feet won’t get trapped in the stones.
verses.13: On Shachal and Pethan, the path will be marked by paths like Kefir and Tanin.
verses.14: For in me there is sorrow and despair; I will bring them down, because I know His name.
verses.15: Let them call upon me, and I will answer them together with them. I will help them and protect them.
verses.16: May I prolong his days, and see him in my time of deliverance.
